Class FilterGuiGraphicsExtractor

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor
org.moddingx.libx.render.FilterGuiGraphicsExtractor
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.neoforged.neoforge.client.extensions.GuiGraphicsExtractorExtension
public class FilterGuiGraphicsExtractor extends net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor
A GuiGraphicsExtractor that overrides all methods and passes them through to the given parent. Useful if you need to change the behavior of some methods in some specific part of code.
